name: Statistical Physics
description: Introduction to probability theory and a recap of classical thermodynamics, ensembles, microcanonical, canonical, and grand canonical ensembles, Boltzmann, Fermi-Dirac, and Bose-Einstein statistics, partition functions, thermodynamic properties, kinetic theory of gases, Boltzmann equation and transport phenomena, H-theorem and irreversibility, ideal and quantum gases, interacting spin systems and Ising model.
